prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Welcome to Your Desktop Companion", "Adopt or create a digital friend to keep you company right on your desktop desktop screen."]
1: ["Use the same email you signed up with to restore your existing desktop pets and settings automatically."]
2: ["Choose Your Companion", "Swipe through available pets and select your favorite companion."]
3: ["Sign In to Save Your Pet", "Log in to sync your desktop pet across devices and preserve your progress."]
4: ["Preparing Your Pet Desktop Companion", "Your companion is getting ready. It will appear on your desktop shortly."]
5: ["Official Adoption Summary", "Review your companion details before welcoming them home."]
6: ["Upload bright, well-lit photos with clear focus for the best custom pet rendering results."]
7: ["Right-click your pet on the desktop or click the system tray icon to open controls, hide, or interact."]
8: ["Select custom or pre-made — you can customize your pet's appearance and behavior anytime later."]
9: ["Once ready, your pet will dock to your desktop taskbar and system tray for easy access."]
